description: Agentic coding assistant running on your own LM Studio model. Chat, files, folders and terminal.
trust.description: SyntaxCoder writes files and runs commands in the workspace, so it only works in trusted folders.
cfg.host: LM Studio host (IP or name), e.g. 127.0.0.1 or 192.168.1.20
cfg.port: LM Studio server port (Local Server), 1234 by default
cfg.https: Use https instead of http, e.g. behind a reverse proxy. Typing https://… in the host field also turns it on.
cfg.apiKey: API key sent as Bearer when no API token is saved. Prefer the API token in the chat settings panel: it is stored in the system keychain, not in settings.json.
cfg.model: LM Studio model id. Empty = first loaded model.
cfg.autoApproveWrites: Write and edit files without approval
cfg.autonomousMode: Autonomous mode: the model writes files and runs commands WITHOUT asking. Turn on only in projects you trust.
cfg.reviewer: Reviewer: after file changes, a second model pass checks the task from the prompt was done. Gaps go back to the agent (max 4 fix rounds).
cfg.planMode: Plan mode: the agent first reads the code and saves a plan of steps (read-only tools). Changes start only after you click Execute plan in the chat.
cfg.inlineCompletions: Inline suggestions: as you type, the model suggests the rest of the code as grey text (Tab accepts). The code around the cursor goes to LM Studio; files with secrets (.env, *.key …) are skipped.
cfg.completionModel: LM Studio model for inline suggestions. Empty = chat model. A small coder model with fill-in-the-middle (e.g. Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B) answers fastest.
cfg.language.auto: Same as VS Code (English if not supported)
